    <!-- loading layout replaced by app after startupp -->
    <app-root>
      <style type="text/css">
        /* spinner styles to display USGS logo and spinner */

        body,
        html {
          height: 100%;
        }

        noscript {
          display: block;
          margin: 1em;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .app-loading {
          align-items: center;
          background-color: #3d5e80;
          display: none;
          flex-direction: column;
          height: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          right: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
        }

        .enabled > .app-loading {
          display: flex;

    <app-root>
      <style type="text/css">
        /* spinner styles to display USGS logo and spinner */

        body,
        html {
          height: 100%;
        }

        noscript {
          display: block;
          margin: 1em;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .app-loading {
          align-items: center;
          background-color: #3d5e80;
          display: none;
          flex-direction: column;
          height: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          right: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
        }

        .enabled > .app-loading {
          display: flex;
        }

        .app-loading > .logo {
          width: 25%;
          max-width: 300px;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner {
          height: 50vh;
          width: 50vw;
          animation: rotate 2s linear infinite;
          transform-origin: center center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          margin: auto;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner > .path {
          stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          animation: dash 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
          stroke-linecap: round;
          stroke: #304a67;
        }

        .app-loading > .instructions {
          background-color: #304a67;
          border-radius: 3px;
          bottom: 0;
          color: #fff;
          display: block;
          font-family: Helvetica, sans-serif;
          font-size: 0.77em;
          left: 0;
          line-height: 1.5;
          margin: 1em;
          padding: 0 1em;
          position: absolute;
          right: 0;
        }

        .instructions > p > a {
          color: #bbb;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
          100% {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }

        @keyframes dash {
          0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          }

          50% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -35px;
          }

          100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -124px;
          }
        }
      </style>

    <!-- loading layout replaced by app after startupp -->
    <app-root>
      <style type="text/css">
        /* spinner styles to display USGS logo and spinner */

        body,
        html {
          height: 100%;
        }

        noscript {
          display: block;
          margin: 1em;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .app-loading {
          align-items: center;
          background-color: #3d5e80;
          display: none;
          flex-direction: column;
          height: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          right: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
        }

        .enabled > .app-loading {
          display: flex;
        }

        .app-loading > .logo {
          width: 25%;
          max-width: 300px;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner {
          height: 50vh;
          width: 50vw;
          animation: rotate 2s linear infinite;
          transform-origin: center center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          margin: auto;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner > .path {
          stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          animation: dash 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
          stroke-linecap: round;
          stroke: #304a67;
        }

        .app-loading > .instructions {
          background-color: #304a67;
          border-radius: 3px;
          bottom: 0;
          color: #fff;
          display: block;
          font-family: Helvetica, sans-serif;
          font-size: 0.77em;
          left: 0;
          line-height: 1.5;
          margin: 1em;
          padding: 0 1em;
          position: absolute;
          right: 0;
        }

        .instructions > p > a {
          color: #bbb;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
          100% {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }

        @keyframes dash {
          0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          }

          50% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -35px;
          }

          100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -124px;
          }
        }
      </style>

    <app-root>
      <style type="text/css">
        /* spinner styles to display USGS logo and spinner */

        body,
        html {
          height: 100%;
        }

        noscript {
          display: block;
          margin: 1em;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .app-loading {
          align-items: center;
          background-color: #3d5e80;
          display: none;
          flex-direction: column;
          height: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          right: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
        }

        .enabled > .app-loading {
          display: flex;
        }

        .app-loading > .logo {
          width: 25%;
          max-width: 300px;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner {
          height: 50vh;
          width: 50vw;
          animation: rotate 2s linear infinite;
          transform-origin: center center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          margin: auto;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner > .path {
          stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          animation: dash 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
          stroke-linecap: round;
          stroke: #304a67;
        }

        .app-loading > .instructions {
          background-color: #304a67;
          border-radius: 3px;
          bottom: 0;
          color: #fff;
          display: block;
          font-family: Helvetica, sans-serif;
          font-size: 0.77em;
          left: 0;
          line-height: 1.5;
          margin: 1em;
          padding: 0 1em;
          position: absolute;
          right: 0;
        }

        .instructions > p > a {
          color: #bbb;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
          100% {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }

        @keyframes dash {
          0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          }

          50% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -35px;
          }

          100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -124px;
          }
        }
      </style>

    <app-root>

        /* spinner styles to display USGS logo and spinner */

        body,
        html {
          height: 100%;
        }

        noscript {
          display: block;
          margin: 1em;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .app-loading {
          align-items: center;
          background-color: #3d5e80;
          display: none;
          flex-direction: column;
          height: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          right: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
        }

        .enabled > .app-loading {
          display: flex;
        }

        .app-loading > .logo {
          width: 25%;
          max-width: 300px;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner {
          height: 50vh;
          width: 50vw;
          animation: rotate 2s linear infinite;
          transform-origin: center center;
          position: absolute;
          top: 0;
          bottom: 0;
          left: 0;
          right: 0;
          margin: auto;
        }

        .app-loading > .spinner > .path {
          stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
          stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          animation: dash 1.5s ease-in-out infinite;
          stroke-linecap: round;
          stroke: #304a67;
        }

        .app-loading > .instructions {
          background-color: #304a67;
          border-radius: 3px;
          bottom: 0;
          color: #fff;
          display: block;
          font-family: Helvetica, sans-serif;
          font-size: 0.77em;
          left: 0;
          line-height: 1.5;
          margin: 1em;
          padding: 0 1em;
          position: absolute;
          right: 0;
        }

        .instructions > p > a {
          color: #bbb;
        }

        @keyframes rotate {
          100% {
            transform: rotate(360deg);
          }
        }

        @keyframes dash {
          0% {
            stroke-dasharray: 1, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: 0;
          }

          50% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -35px;
          }

          100% {
            stroke-dasharray: 89, 200;
            stroke-dashoffset: -124px;
          }
        }
